title: Policy-backed worker pressure thresholds and reserve-preserving dynamic admission
observed_behavior: internal/service/worker_pressure_evaluator.go exposed DefaultWorkerPressureThresholds and processor/admission paths used those hardcoded defaults directly.
internal/service/worker_admission.go used requiredAfterReserve(min,reserve), allowing a dynamic placement with only one byte free when the workload minimum was less than or equal to the reserve.
LLM and ML placement fixtures encoded exact-fit VRAM as eligible, which did not prove reserve preservation.
intended_behavior: Bahia config owns worker pressure policy defaults and supports operator overrides under worker_pressure.
Nostr worker advertisement processing assesses pressure with the configured thresholds wired by app.New.
Worker admission dynamic headroom requires workload minimum plus the warning reserve for memory, disk, and VRAM.
Placement services pass configured thresholds into admission and tests model workers with explicit reserve headroom where eligibility is expected.
